learning_outcomes.text: Understand the operating principles of fluid-mechanical machines.
Be able to size hydraulic pumps and hydraulic turbines.
Be able to calculate and size a fluid installation.
Be able to apply dimensional analysis and similarity in the study of hydraulic machines.
Be able to perform simulations of fluid-mechanical systems and machines, interpret the obtained results, and draw conclusions.
Be able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Energy balance in a hydraulic machine
Ideal one-dimensional theory of hydraulic turbomachines
teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts and problem solving, discussion sessions, sharing of ideas
Personal study, report writing, practical exercises
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.45 times Partial Exam 1, plus 0.45 times Partial Exam 2, plus 0.1 times the Practical work grade. Two partial exams are eliminatory, requiring a minimum score of 4 on each. Students have the possibility to retake one or all partials in a final exam during the ordinary or extraordinary call.
